definitions.explanation: A prefix indicating something is on top or in a higher position.
A prefix indicating the outer layer or surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧。
⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{履|は}き{替|か}える→履き替える：06680_hakikaeru⟧。
⟦{上|うわ}{棚|だな}→上棚：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I put luggage on the upper shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上|うわ}べ→うわべ：noentry⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{優|やさ}しさ→優しさ：25588_yasashisa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見抜|みぬ}かれる→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧。
examples.english: Kindness that is only on the surface will be seen through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上|うわ}{塗|ぬ}り→上塗り：16966_uwanuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{剥|は}がれて→剥がれる：04363_hagareru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The outer coat of paint has started peeling off.

notes:
{上|うわ}〜 is a prefix meaning 'upper' or 'outer.'

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧: jacket, outerwear
- ⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧: indoor shoes (slippers for inside)
- ⟦{上|うわ}の{空|そら}→上の空：10094_uwanosora⟧: absent-minded, distracted
- ⟦{上手|うわて}→上手：noentry⟧: upper hand, better (at something)
- ⟦{上向|うわむ}き→上向き：noentry⟧: facing upward, upward trend
- ⟦{上塗|うわぬ}り→上塗り：16966_uwanuri⟧: top coat (of paint)
- ⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to exceed, to surpass

CONTRAST WITH {下|した}〜:
- ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧ ↔ ⟦{下着|したぎ}→下着：01605_shitagi⟧ (outerwear ↔ underwear)
- ⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧ ↔ ⟦{外履|そとば}き→外履き：noentry⟧ (indoor shoes ↔ outdoor shoes)
